flows.title: Create a label
steps: On the left, next to "Labels," click Create label.
Type a name, then click Save.

flows.title: Add contacts to a label
steps: Check the box next to each contact you want. To take every one, check the box next to any contact and, in the top left, click Selection Actions, then All.
At the top, click Manage labels.
Click the label you want, then click Apply.

flows.title: Export contacts to a file
steps: Check the box next to each contact you want. To take every one, check the box next to any contact and, in the top left, click Selection Actions, then All.
At the top right, click More actions, then Export.
Select Google CSV, then click Export.
